dialogue.speaker: Static Voice
dialogue.text: You are dead. Someone you trusted put the gun against your chest. Find the Ledger.

dialogue.speaker: The Butcher
dialogue.text: The man who hired me said the contract could bring the dead back. He knew your name before I did.

dialogue.speaker: The Strategist
dialogue.text: Your friend knew the Ledger had marked you. He crossed out my order, but still pulled the trigger.

dialogue.speaker: Ledger Keeper
dialogue.text: At least one claimant must be defeated. Two names are crossed out. The passage is paid.

dialogue.speaker: The Betrayer
dialogue.text: I chose your death as a controlled crossing, hoping you could break the claim. I did not ask you. I was afraid, too.
